rules: Classify only user-role rows. Assistant rows are never relayed messages.

[bb automation due:<id>] at the very start, any initiator: kind automation. Sender is the name in a leading Check-in "<name>": or Reminder "<name>" (<when>): line, else Automation; the summary starts after that name.
[bb message from thread:<id>] or [bb message from thread:<id>;…] at the very start, initiator not user: kind agent, senderThreadId <id>. The body after the header is read as a body (below).
[bb system] at the very start, initiator not user: kind system, sender BB Studio.

[bb studio] at the very start, any initiator: Studio wrote the line. The text after the header (and any blank lines) is read as a Studio line (below); if none matches, kind studio, sender BB Studio, the summary from after the header.
Any other text, any initiator: not relayed.
Initiator user (or unknown) with no header: not relayed, even when it starts like a Studio line (Watcher <name>:, From runner <name>:), since a person may type that.

Body: a leading [bb studio] header is skipped; then (⚠️ )?From runner <name>: gives kind runner, sender "runner <name>", urgent when ⚠️; Studio's lines give kind studio; otherwise a leading tag of 2+ capitals with an optional lowercase word and a colon (LEAD:, LEAD bb-studio:) is dropped from the summary.

Studio lines: Watcher <name>: (sender "watcher <name>"), 🗓 <tool> from [<title>](/threads/<id>): (sender <title>), and with sender BB Studio and the line kept whole: 📥 Handed to you:, ↻ Resumed after a restart, ⚠️ "<title>" stopped again (, ⚠️ <name> is off: BB turned it off again (, Maintenance: <n> threads need your call ; The reviewer checked round <n> of "<design>" and found problems: (sender design review).
Sender for kind agent is the sending thread's title, else "another conversation".

Summary: the first non-empty line from the summary start; leading > # - * 1. markers, markdown links (to their text), ** __ and backticks removed; whitespace collapsed; cut after the first . ! or ? followed by a space; at most 100 characters, cut at a word with …
Line: From <sender> · <summary>, or From <sender> when the summary is empty.

Fold: a relayed message whose turn's final assistant reply is exactly [PASS] (isPassOutput: any case, wrapped in whitespace, backticks or * _ ~) draws as that one row and nothing else: no Quiet check row. Any other reply draws the relayed row, then the reply as usual.
